The project must choose whether to keep this exclusion or amend it to allow a digital-download refund window. If a window is allowed, it is also unclear whether 'within thirty days' means a request-eligibility window or a maximum processing time, because the claim's facet asks how long a refund may take.

CLAIM-fd97211adcc0f40e has the predicate refund_window, the same predicate as CLAIM-3d861b7bb2cd0eef. Its subject, facet and value all concern where refunds are paid, not the refund request window. The proposed requirement follows the claim's value text. It is unresolved whether the predicate is a mislabel, and the two claims should not be treated as competing refund-window values.

The refund-window address asks how long a refund may take. Its only live claim, CLAIM-3d861b7bb2cd0eef, states only the period within which refund requests may be made, which is already represented. No supplied claim says how long a refund may take to be processed or paid out. Any refund-duration expectation behind the Intent's aim of fast refunds is therefore unresolved.
